- [2023/05/29] The user is trying to understand the Langmuir Sheath effect in the fluid model.
- [2023/05/29] The Langmuir sheath is a region near the boundary between a plasma and a solid surface where an electric field forms due to the difference in mobility between positive ions and negative electrons.
- [2023/05/29] Debye shielding occurs in a plasma when mobile charged particles arrange themselves around a charged object to neutralize its electric field, creating a Debye length.
- [2023/05/29] The electric field within the sheath region accelerates ions towards the surface and repels electrons, maintaining charge separation.
- [2023/05/29] Outside the sheath region, the plasma is quasi-neutral, while inside the sheath, the positive ion density dominates.
- [2023/05/29] The boundary between the plasma and the sheath is called the "sheath edge" or "sheath entrance."
